verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine, so GPU-vendor acceleration is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no NVIDIA, AMD, or other vendor-specific inference kernels. Its local docs say it runs with "no GPU", and community reports say the GPU goes unused for inference on Apple and Pixel devices. Hosted GPUs are mentioned only for fine-tuning, which is a different capability from local inference acceleration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run models on NVIDIA, AMD, or other GPU vendors using vendor-specific acceleration kernels
